fitAnalysis.assessment:
Your 49% match is a Weak Fit for this Senior Search Algorithms role at Elastic.

**Strengths:**
- Java and Kotlin backend experience, including 6 years at senior level
- PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka and RabbitMQ data storage experience
- Open-source bug fixes and code review practice

**Gaps:**
- No search or vector database experience (Elasticsearch, Solr)
- No HNSW, IVF or search algorithm background
- No MongoDB or Cassandra, and no Java lambdas evidence

**Recommendation:** Build a small Elasticsearch or Lucene vector search project, contribute to it in open source, then apply.

coverLetter:
Priya Raman
Toronto, Canada
priya.raman@example.com
+1 555 0176

October 12, 2026

Hiring Manager
Elastic

Dear Hiring Manager,

Your Search Relevance team needs engineers who can own a hard problem from technical design to a shipped fix, and then make the code easier for the next person to read. At Lumen Payments I did that with a slow payment status API: I cut p99 latency from 480 ms to 120 ms by moving hot reads from PostgreSQL to Redis. I haven't worked on search or vector databases, so I won't pretend otherwise. Understanding why a data store behaves as it does under load is the part I know well.

I bring 11 years of experience building event-processing services in Java, Kotlin and Python. At Northgate Retail Systems I wrote Java and Spring services backed by PostgreSQL. Later, as a Senior Software Engineer, I designed a settlement service handling about 40 million events a day on Kafka and led a team of 4 engineers through a 9 month migration from a monolith to 6 services. Code review, API design and written post-incident reviews were part of that daily work, which fits a team that reviews every change and decides big things by consensus. During a career break I kept my skills current and contributed small bug fixes to an open-source Kotlin library, so I'm used to working with maintainers I've never met.

I'd like to talk about how my backend and data storage experience could support the vector search work in Elasticsearch, and I can start a conversation whenever suits your team.

Best regards,
Priya Raman

applicationEmail.subject: Application: Senior Software Engineer, Priya Raman
applicationEmail.body:
Dear Elastic Hiring Team,

At Lumen Payments I cut p99 latency on the payment status API from 480 ms to 120 ms by moving hot reads from PostgreSQL to Redis, and I'd like to bring that kind of data-access tuning, in Java, to your search engineering team. I have 11 years of experience building payment and event-processing services, and I enjoy design work, API reviews and code review. My CV and cover letter are attached for your review. I'm available for a conversation any weekday next week and can start within a month of an offer.

Kind regards,
Priya Raman
